findings.claim: The JSDoc for raceDrivers sits above PLAYER_CAR_COUNT. That makes two stacked doc comments: editors and hovers attach both to the constant, and raceDrivers ends up with no doc at all. The next night that edits the roster could misread which comment describes what.
